name: Shopinzen Integrator
author: nxtcv

sections.description:
Shopinzen Integrator simplifies the process of bringing AI-powered customer engagement to your WordPress site. The plugin facilitates direct account registration with the Shopinzen platform and allows you to link your specific AI chatbot using a secure API key.

Once configured, the plugin automatically handles the technical integration by injecting the necessary chatbot scripts into your site’s header, ensuring your AI assistant is active and visible across all pages using your unique API key.

Key Features:
* Integrated Registration: Create your Shopinzen account directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.
* API Key Based Integration: Connect your AI bot in seconds by providing your Shopinzen API key.
* Automated Deployment: The plugin saves your bot configuration and automatically appends the required integration scripts to your site’s header for instant activation.
* Performance Focused: Light and efficient, ensuring that the AI integration does not slow down your site’s loading speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shopinzen-integrator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Shopinzen Integrator’ in your admin menu to register or link your existing bot.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API Key?

You can generate an API key in your Shopinzen account dashboard after registering either via www.shopinzen.com or through the plugin.

Will the chatbot appear on all pages?

Yes, the plugin automatically injects the integration script into the header of every page to ensure the chatbot is always available to your visitors. However, you can customize this via the Shopinzen dashboard with page filters, so you can decide on which pages the AI chatbot should appear based on a set of rules.
